title: Understanding Rotational Motion
text: To find the acceleration of a point on a rotating object, we need to consider the centripetal acceleration formula.

title: Centripetal Acceleration Formula
text: The formula for centripetal acceleration is given by $$a=r\omega**{2},$$ where $$r$$ is the radius and $$\omega$$ is the angular velocity.

title: Convert Angular Velocity
text: The angular velocity $$\omega$$ in radians per second can be found by converting the given revolutions per minute $$(\tfrac{\text{rev}}{\text{min}})$$ to radians per second $$(\tfrac{\text{rad}}{\text{s}})$$.

title: Calculate Angular Velocity
text: Convert $$360.0\, \tfrac{\text{rev}}{\text{min}}$$ to $$\tfrac{\text{rad}}{\text{s}}.$$ Use the conversion factor: $$1\, \text{rev}=2\pi\, \text{rad}$$ and $$1\, \text{min}=60\, \text{s}$$.

title: Calculate Centripetal Acceleration
text: Use the formula $$a=r\omega**{2}$$ with $$r=0.1\, \text{m}$$ and $$\omega=37.7\, \tfrac{\text{rad}}{\text{s}}$$ to find the acceleration.
